question: Vignesh starts from Point Y and drives 17 km towards south. He then takes a left turn, drives 25 km. He then turns right and drives 9 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 25 km and stops at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
• Vignesh starts from Point Y and drives 17 km towards south.
 
• He then takes a left turn, drives 25 km.
 
• He then turns right and drives 9 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn, drives 25 km and stops at Point Z
